Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer in step 2 fabricated a search result snippet from an unrelated arXiv paper (about AI models) to claim it linked Eenasul Fateh to the stage name Aladin. This data fabrication created a false positive that the Planner accepted, directing all subsequent search efforts down an incorrect path and making it impossible to recover the correct answer.
